input.args: Issue 750: thenReturn(mJson) does not pick up later changes to mJson, while thenAnswer returning mJson does. Mockito source directory mockito/ appears empty in this workspace (Grep and Glob find no files), so no Mockito source was checked.

final: {"number": 750, "label": "question", "route": "answer", "related": [1168, 2366], "evidence": [], "reply": "Thanks for the report. This is expected behaviour rather than a bug. The value you pass to the return call is read once, when that line runs. If mJson is null or still holds an old value at that moment, the stub keeps returning that value even after mJson changes later. The callback version works because it reads mJson each time the mock is called. To fix it, either set mJson before you define the stub, or use the callback form so the value is read at call time. The Mockito source was not available in this workspace, so I could not check exact API names here."}
